    elif field_name == "sha512":
        value = hash_file(path, "sha512", env)
    elif field_name == "sha3":
        value = hash_file(path, "sha3_512", env)
    else:
        value = ""
    row.cache[field_name] = value
    return value


def eval_identifier(expr: Identifier, env: EvalEnv) -> Any:
    if expr.qualifier is not None:
        target = env.aliases.get(expr.qualifier)
        if target is None:
            return ""
        return row_field(target, expr.name, env)
    if env.row is None:
        return ""
    return row_field(env.row, expr.name, env)


def literal_text(value: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value
    return stringify(value)


def is_truthy_value(value: Any) -> bool:
    return isinstance(value, bool) and value


def sql_like_to_regex(pattern: str) -> str:
    regex = ["^"]
    for char in pattern:
        if char == "%":
            regex.append(".*")
        elif char == "_":
            regex.append(".")
        else:
            regex.append(re.escape(char))
    regex.append("$")
    return "".join(regex)


def compare_values(op: str, left: Any, right: Any, right_expr: Expr, env: EvalEnv) -> bool:
    op = op.lower()
    if isinstance(left, datetime):
        literal = right_expr.raw if isinstance(right_expr, Literal) else literal_text(right)
        result = compare_datetimes(left, op, literal, env.runtime)
        if result is not None:
            return result
    left_bool = parse_bool_like(left)
    right_bool = parse_bool_like(right)
    if left_bool is not None and right_bool is not None and op in {"=", "==", "eq", "!=", "<>", "ne", "===", "eeq", "!==", "ene"}:
        if op in {"=", "==", "eq", "===", "eeq"}:
            return left_bool == right_bool
        return left_bool != right_bool
    left_num: Optional[float] = None
    right_num: Optional[float] = None
    if isinstance(left, (int, float)):
        left_num = float(left)
    elif isinstance(left, str):
        if is_number_string(left):
            left_num = float(left)
        else:
            left_num = parse_size_literal(left)
    if isinstance(right, (int, float)):
        right_num = float(right)
    elif isinstance(right, str):
        if is_number_string(right):
            right_num = float(right)
        else:
            right_num = parse_size_literal(right)
    if left_num is not None and right_num is not None:
        if op in {"=", "==", "eq", "===", "eeq"}:
            return left_num == right_num
        if op in {"!=", "<>", "ne", "!==", "ene"}:
            return left_num != right_num
        if op in {">", "gt"}:
            return left_num > right_num
        if op in {">=", "gte", "ge"}:
            return left_num >= right_num
        if op in {"<", "lt"}:
            return left_num < right_num
        if op in {"<=", "lte", "le"}:
            return left_num <= right_num
    left_text = literal_text(left)
    right_text = literal_text(right)
    if op in {"=", "==", "eq"}:
        if "*" in right_text or "?" in right_text:
            return fnmatch.fnmatchcase(left_text, right_text)
        return left_text == right_text
    if op in {"!=", "<>", "ne"}:
        if "*" in right_text or "?" in right_text:
            return not fnmatch.fnmatchcase(left_text, right_text)
        return left_text != right_text
    if op in {"===", "eeq"}:
        return left_text == right_text
    if op in {"!==", "ene"}:
        return left_text != right_text
    if op in {">", "gt"}:
        return left_text > right_text
    if op in {">=", "gte", "ge"}:
        return left_text >= right_text
    if op in {"<", "lt"}:
        return left_text < right_text
    if op in {"<=", "lte", "le"}:
        return left_text <= right_text
    if op in {"=~", "~=", "regexp", "rx"}:
        try:
            return re.search(right_text, left_text) is not None
        except re.error:
            return False
    if op in {"!=~", "!~=", "notrx"}:
        try:
            return re.search(right_text, left_text) is None
        except re.error:
            return True
    if op == "like":
        return re.fullmatch(sql_like_to_regex(right_text), left_text) is not None
    if op == "notlike":
        return re.fullmatch(sql_like_to_regex(right_text), left_text) is None
    return False


def eval_expr(expr: Expr, env: EvalEnv, group_rows: Optional[list[EvalEnv]] = None) -> Any:
    if isinstance(expr, Literal):
        return expr.value
    if isinstance(expr, Identifier):
        return eval_identifier(expr, env)
    if isinstance(expr, Star):
        return "*"
    if isinstance(expr, UnaryOp):
        value = eval_expr(expr.operand, env, group_rows)
        if expr.op == "not":
            return not is_truthy_value(value)
        if expr.op == "-":
            try:
                return -float(value)
            except Exception:
                return ""
        return value
    if isinstance(expr, BinaryOp):
        if expr.op == "or":
            return is_truthy_value(eval_expr(expr.left, env, group_rows)) or is_truthy_value(eval_expr(expr.right, env, group_rows))
        if expr.op == "and":
            return is_truthy_value(eval_expr(expr.left, env, group_rows)) and is_truthy_value(eval_expr(expr.right, env, group_rows))
        left = eval_expr(expr.left, env, group_rows)
        right = eval_expr(expr.right, env, group_rows)
        left_num = parse_number(str(left)) if is_number_string(str(left)) else float(left) if isinstance(left, (int, float)) else None
        right_num = parse_number(str(right)) if is_number_string(str(right)) else float(right) if isinstance(right, (int, float)) else None
        if left_num is None or right_num is None:
            return ""
        if expr.op == "+":
            return left_num + right_num
        if expr.op == "-":
            return left_num - right_num
        if expr.op == "*":
            return left_num * right_num
        if expr.op == "/":
            try:
                return left_num / right_num
            except ZeroDivisionError:
                return ""
        if expr.op == "%":
            try:
                return left_num % right_num
            except ZeroDivisionError:
                return ""
        return ""
    if isinstance(expr, CompareOp):
        left = eval_expr(expr.left, env, group_rows)
        right = eval_expr(expr.right, env, group_rows)
        return compare_values(expr.op, left, right, expr.right, env)
    if isinstance(expr, BetweenOp):
        left = eval_expr(expr.left, env, group_rows)
        low = eval_expr(expr.low, env, group_rows)
        high = eval_expr(expr.high, env, group_rows)
        result = compare_values(">=", left, low, expr.low, env) and compare_values("<=", left, high, expr.high, env)
        return not result if expr.negated else result
    if isinstance(expr, InOp):
        left = eval_expr(expr.left, env, group_rows)
        found = False
        if isinstance(expr.options, SubqueryExpr):
            results = execute_query(expr.options.query, env.runtime, env.aliases, collect_output=True)
            candidates = [row[0] if row else "" for row in results.output_rows]
            found = any(compare_values("=", left, candidate, Literal(stringify(candidate), stringify(candidate)), env) for candidate in candidates)
        else:
            candidates = [eval_expr(option, env, group_rows) for option in expr.options]
            found = any(compare_values("=", left, candidate, Literal(stringify(candidate), stringify(candidate)), env) for candidate in candidates)
        return not found if expr.negated else found
    if isinstance(expr, ExistsOp):
        results = execute_query(expr.subquery.query, env.runtime, env.aliases, collect_output=True)
        found = bool(results.output_rows)
        return not found if expr.negated else found
    if isinstance(expr, FunctionCall):
        return eval_function(expr, env, group_rows)
    if isinstance(expr, SubqueryExpr):
        results = execute_query(expr.query, env.runtime, env.aliases, collect_output=True)
        if results.output_rows:
            return results.output_rows[0][0]
        return ""
    return ""


def aggregate_values(name: str, values: list[Any]) -> Any:
    cleaned = [value for value in values if value not in {None, ""}]
    if name == "count":
        return len(cleaned)
    if not cleaned:
        return ""
    if name in {"sum", "avg", "stddev_pop", "stddev_samp", "var_pop", "var_samp"}:
        nums = [float(value) for value in cleaned]
        if name == "sum":
            return sum(nums)
        if name == "avg":
            return sum(nums) / len(nums)
        if name == "stddev_pop":
            if len(nums) == 1:
                return 0
            avg = sum(nums) / len(nums)
            return math.sqrt(sum((value - avg) ** 2 for value in nums) / len(nums))
        if name == "stddev_samp":
            if len(nums) < 2:
                return ""
            avg = sum(nums) / len(nums)
            return math.sqrt(sum((value - avg) ** 2 for value in nums) / (len(nums) - 1))
        if name == "var_pop":
            if len(nums) == 1:
                return 0
            avg = sum(nums) / len(nums)
            return sum((value - avg) ** 2 for value in nums) / len(nums)
        if name == "var_samp":
            if len(nums) < 2:
                return ""
            avg = sum(nums) / len(nums)
            return sum((value - avg) ** 2 for value in nums) / (len(nums) - 1)
    sorted_values = sorted(cleaned, key=sort_value)
    if name == "min":
        return sorted_values[0]
    if name == "max":
        return sorted_values[-1]
    return ""


def contains_japanese(text: str) -> bool:
    return any(
        ("\u3040" <= char <= "\u30ff") or ("\u4e00" <= char <= "\u9faf")
        for char in text
    )


def contains_hiragana(text: str) -> bool:
    return any("\u3040" <= char <= "\u309f" for char in text)


def contains_katakana(text: str) -> bool:
    return any("\u30a0" <= char <= "\u30ff" for char in text)


def contains_kanji(text: str) -> bool:
    return any("\u4e00" <= char <= "\u9faf" for char in text)


def contains_greek(text: str) -> bool:
    return any("\u0370" <= char <= "\u03ff" for char in text)


def normalize_datetime_arg(value: Any) -> Optional[datetime]:
    if isinstance(value, datetime):
        return value
    if isinstance(value, date):
        return datetime.combine(value, time())
    if isinstance(value, str):
        spec = parse_date_spec(value, RuntimeOptions())
        if spec is not None:
            return spec[0]
        for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", "%Y-%m-%d"):
            try:
                return datetime.strptime(value, fmt)
            except ValueError:
                continue
    return None


def eval_function(expr: FunctionCall, env: EvalEnv, group_rows: Optional[list[EvalEnv]]) -> Any:
    name = expr.name
    if name in AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS:
        rows = group_rows or []
        if name == "count" and expr.args and isinstance(expr.args[0], Star):
            return len(rows)
        values = [eval_expr(expr.args[0], row_env, None) for row_env in rows] if expr.args else []
        return aggregate_values(name, values)

    args = [eval_expr(arg, env, group_rows) for arg in expr.args]
    text0 = stringify(args[0]) if args else ""
    if name == "lower":
        return text0.lower()
    if name == "upper":
        return text0.upper()
    if name == "initcap":
        return text0.title()
    if name == "length":
        return len(text0)
    if name == "to_base64":
        return base64.b64encode(text0.encode("utf-8")).decode("ascii")
    if name == "from_base64":
        try:
            return base64.b64decode(text0).decode("utf-8")
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "concat":
        return "".join(stringify(arg) for arg in args)
    if name == "concat_ws":
        if not args:
            return ""
        sep = stringify(args[0])
        return sep.join(stringify(arg) for arg in args[1:])
    if name == "locate":
        if len(args) < 2:
            return 0
        pos = stringify(args[0]).find(stringify(args[1]))
        return pos + 1 if pos >= 0 else 0
    if name == "substr":
        if len(args) < 2:
            return ""
        start = int(float(args[1])) - 1
        length = int(float(args[2])) if len(args) > 2 else None
        return stringify(args[0])[start:] if length is None else stringify(args[0])[start:start + length]
    if name == "replace":
        if len(args) < 3:
            return text0
        return stringify(args[0]).replace(stringify(args[1]), stringify(args[2]))
    if name == "trim":
        return text0.strip()
    if name == "ltrim":
        return text0.lstrip()
    if name == "rtrim":
        return text0.rstrip()
    if name == "contains_japanese":
        return contains_japanese(text0)
    if name == "contains_hiragana":
        return contains_hiragana(text0)
    if name == "contains_katakana":
        return contains_katakana(text0)
    if name == "contains_kana":
        return contains_hiragana(text0) or contains_katakana(text0)
    if name == "contains_kanji":
        return contains_kanji(text0)
    if name == "contains_greek":
        return contains_greek(text0)
    if name == "bin":
        try:
            return format(int(float(args[0])), "b")
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "hex":
        try:
            return format(int(float(args[0])), "x")
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "oct":
        try:
            return format(int(float(args[0])), "o")
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "abs":
        try:
            return abs(float(args[0]))
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "power":
        try:
            return float(args[0]) ** float(args[1])
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "sqrt":
        try:
            return math.sqrt(float(args[0]))
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "log":
        try:
            return math.log(float(args[0]), float(args[1]))
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "ln":
        try:
            return math.log(float(args[0]))
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "exp":
        try:
            return math.exp(float(args[0]))
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "least":
        return min(args, key=sort_value) if args else ""
    if name == "greatest":
        return max(args, key=sort_value) if args else ""
    if name == "pi":
        return math.pi
    if name == "floor":
        try:
            return math.floor(float(args[0]))
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "ceil":
        try:
            return math.ceil(float(args[0]))
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "round":
        try:
            if len(args) > 1:
                return round(float(args[0]), int(float(args[1])))
            return round(float(args[0]))
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "rand":
        if not args:
            return random.random()
        if len(args) == 1:
            return random.uniform(0, float(args[0]))
        return random.uniform(float(args[0]), float(args[1]))
    if name == "current_date":
        return datetime.now().date()
    if name == "current_time":
        return datetime.now().time().replace(microsecond=0)
    if name == "current_timestamp":
        return datetime.now().replace(microsecond=0)
    if name == "day":
        dt = normalize_datetime_arg(args[0]) if args else None
        return dt.day if dt else ""
    if name == "month":
        dt = normalize_datetime_arg(args[0]) if args else None
        return dt.month if dt else ""
    if name == "year":
        dt = normalize_datetime_arg(args[0]) if args else None
        return dt.year if dt else ""
    if name == "dayofweek":
        dt = normalize_datetime_arg(args[0]) if args else None
        return ((dt.weekday() + 1) % 7) + 1 if dt else ""
    if name == "dayname":
        dt = normalize_datetime_arg(args[0]) if args else None
        return dt.strftime("%A") if dt else ""
    if name == "dayofyear":
        dt = normalize_datetime_arg(args[0]) if args else None
        return dt.timetuple().tm_yday if dt else ""
    if name == "date_add":
        dt = normalize_datetime_arg(args[0]) if args else None
        if dt is None:
            return ""
        return dt + timedelta(days=int(float(args[1])))
    if name == "date_sub":
        dt = normalize_datetime_arg(args[0]) if args else None
        if dt is None:
            return ""
        return dt - timedelta(days=int(float(args[1])))
    if name == "date_diff":
        left = normalize_datetime_arg(args[0]) if args else None
        right = normalize_datetime_arg(args[1]) if len(args) > 1 else None
        if left is None or right is None:
            return ""
        return (left.date() - right.date()).days
    if name == "from_unixtime":
        try:
            return datetime.fromtimestamp(float(args[0])).replace(microsecond=0)
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "last_day":
        dt = normalize_datetime_arg(args[0]) if args else None
        if dt is None:
            return ""
        if dt.month == 12:
            next_month = datetime(dt.year + 1, 1, 1)
        else:
            next_month = datetime(dt.year, dt.month + 1, 1)
        return (next_month - timedelta(days=1)).date()
    if name == "has_xattr":
        return stringify(args[0]) in list_xattrs(env.row.real_path) if env.row is not None and args else False
    if name == "xattr":
        if env.row is None or not args or not hasattr(os, "getxattr"):
            return ""
        try:
            data = os.getxattr(env.row.real_path, stringify(args[0]), follow_symlinks=False)
            return decode_text(data) or ""
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "has_extattr":
        return stringify(args[0]) in stringify(row_field(env.row, "extattrs", env)) if env.row is not None and args else False
    if name in {"has_acl_entry", "has_default_acl_entry", "has_capability"}:
        return False
    if name in {"acl_entry", "default_acl_entry"}:
        return ""
    if name == "format_size":
        try:
            return format_size(float(args[0]))
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "format_time":
        return format_duration(args[0]) if args else ""
    if name == "current_uid":
        return os.getuid()
    if name == "current_user":
        try:
            return pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_name
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "current_gid":
        return os.getgid()
    if name == "current_group":
        try:
            return grp.getgrgid(os.getgid()).gr_name
        except Exception:
            return ""
    if name == "contains":
        if env.row is None or len(args) < 1:
            return False
        needle = stringify(args[0]).encode("utf-8")
        return needle in read_file_bytes(env.row.real_path, env)
    if name == "coalesce":
        for arg in args:
            if arg not in {"", None}:
                return arg
        return ""
    return ""


def expr_label(expr: Expr) -> str:
    if isinstance(expr, Identifier):
        return FIELD_LABELS.get(expr.name, " ".join(part.capitalize() for part in expr.name.split("_")))
    if isinstance(expr, Literal):
        return expr.raw
    if isinstance(expr, Star):
        return "*"
    if isinstance(expr, FunctionCall):
        if expr.name in AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS:
            args = ", ".join(expr_label_lower(arg) for arg in expr.args)
            return f"{expr.name}({args})"
        args = ", ".join(expr_label(arg) for arg in expr.args)
        return f"{' '.join(part.capitalize() for part in expr.name.split('_'))}({args})"
    if isinstance(expr, BinaryOp):
        return f"{expr_label(expr.left)} {expr.op} {expr_label(expr.right)}"
    if isinstance(expr, UnaryOp):
        return f"{expr.op} {expr_label(expr.operand)}"
    if isinstance(expr, CompareOp):
        return f"{expr_label(expr.left)} {expr.op} {expr_label(expr.right)}"
    if isinstance(expr, BetweenOp):
        return f"{expr_label(expr.left)} between {expr_label(expr.low)} and {expr_label(expr.high)}"
    if isinstance(expr, InOp):
        return f"{expr_label(expr.left)} in (...)"
    if isinstance(expr, ExistsOp):
        return "exists (...)"
    return ""


def expr_label_lower(expr: Expr) -> str:
    if isinstance(expr, Identifier):
        return expr.name
    if isinstance(expr, Literal):
        return expr.raw
    if isinstance(expr, Star):
        return "*"
    if isinstance(expr, FunctionCall):
        args = ", ".join(expr_label_lower(arg) for arg in expr.args)
        return f"{expr.name}({args})"
    return expr_label(expr).lower()


@dataclass
class ExecutionResult:
    output_rows: list[list[Any]]
    labels: list[str]
    errors: list[str]
    exit_code: int


def execute_query(
    query: Query,
    runtime: RuntimeOptions,
    outer_aliases: Optional[dict[str, FileRow]] = None,
    collect_output: bool = False,
) -> ExecutionResult:
    outer_aliases = dict(outer_aliases or {})
    errors: list[str] = []
    all_envs: list[EvalEnv] = []
    for root in query.roots:
        for row in walk_root(root, errors):
            aliases = dict(outer_aliases)
            if root.alias:
                aliases[root.alias] = row
            all_envs.append(EvalEnv(row, aliases, runtime, errors))
    filtered_envs = [env for env in all_envs if query.where_expr is None or is_truthy_value(eval_expr(query.where_expr, env))]

    has_aggregate = any(expr.has_aggregate() for expr in query.select_exprs)
    labels = [expr_label(expr) for expr in query.select_exprs]
    rows: list[list[Any]] = []
    order_contexts: list[Any] = []

    if has_aggregate or query.group_by:
        grouped: "OrderedDict[tuple[Any, ...], list[EvalEnv]]" = OrderedDict()
        if filtered_envs:
            for env in filtered_envs:
                key = tuple(eval_expr(expr, env) for expr in query.group_by) if query.group_by else ("__all__",)
                grouped.setdefault(key, []).append(env)
        elif has_aggregate and not query.group_by:
            grouped[("__all__",)] = []
        for group_rows in grouped.values():
            base_env = group_rows[0] if group_rows else EvalEnv(None, dict(outer_aliases), runtime, errors)
            row_values = [eval_expr(expr, base_env, group_rows) for expr in query.select_exprs]
            rows.append(row_values)
            order_contexts.append((base_env, group_rows))
    else:
        for env in filtered_envs:
            rows.append([eval_expr(expr, env) for expr in query.select_exprs])
            order_contexts.append((env, None))

    if query.order_by:
        indexed = list(zip(rows, order_contexts))
        for order_spec in reversed(query.order_by):
            if order_spec.position is not None:
                index = max(order_spec.position - 1, 0)
                indexed.sort(key=lambda item: sort_value(item[0][index] if index < len(item[0]) else ""), reverse=order_spec.descending)
            else:
                indexed.sort(
                    key=lambda item: sort_value(eval_expr(order_spec.expr, item[1][0], item[1][1])),
                    reverse=order_spec.descending,
                )
        rows = [item[0] for item in indexed]

    if query.offset:
        rows = rows[query.offset:]
    if query.limit is not None:
        rows = rows[: query.limit]
    return ExecutionResult(rows, labels, errors, 1 if errors else 0)


def render_output(query: Query, result: ExecutionResult) -> str:
    rows = [[stringify(value) for value in row] for row in result.output_rows]
    if query.fmt == "tabs":
        return "".join("\t".join(row) + "\n" for row in rows)
    if query.fmt == "lines":
        return "".join(value + "\n" for row in rows for value in row)
    if query.fmt == "list":
        return "".join(value + "\0" for row in rows for value in row)
    if query.fmt == "csv":
        out: list[str] = []
        from io import StringIO

        handle = StringIO()
        writer = csv.writer(handle, lineterminator="\n")
        for row in rows:
            writer.writerow(row)
        return handle.getvalue()
    if query.fmt == "json":
        parts: list[str] = []
        for row in rows:
            items = list(zip(result.labels, row))
            items.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
            obj = "{" + ",".join(f"{json_escape(label)}:{json_escape(value)}" for label, value in items) + "}"
            parts.append(obj)
        return "[" + ",".join(parts) + "]"
    if query.fmt == "html":
        title = html.escape(query.original)
        rows_html = "".join(
            "<tr>" + "".join(f"<td>{html.escape(value)}</td>" for value in row) + "</tr>"
            for row in rows
        )
        return f"<html><head><title>{title}</title></head><body><table><tr><th colspan=\"{len(result.labels)}\">{title}</th></tr>{rows_html}</table></body></html>"
    return ""


def json_escape(text: str) -> str:
    return "\"" + (
        text.replace("\\", "\\\\")
        .replace("\"", "\\\"")
        .replace("\b", "\\b")
        .replace("\f", "\\f")
        .replace("\n", "\\n")
        .replace("\r", "\\r")
        .replace("\t", "\\t")
    ) + "\""


def load_config(path: str, runtime: RuntimeOptions) -> Optional[str]:
    try:
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            lines = handle.readlines()
    except OSError:
        return "Could not open config file. Using default settings.\n"
    for raw in lines:
        line = raw.split("#", 1)[0].strip()
        if not line or "=" not in line:
            continue
        key, value = [part.strip() for part in line.split("=", 1)]
        low_key = key.lower()
        low_value = value.lower()
        if low_key == "us_dates":
            runtime.us_dates = low_value == "true"
    return None


def parse_cli(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[RuntimeOptions, str, Optional[str], bool]:
    runtime = RuntimeOptions(show_errors=not bool(os.environ.get("NO_COLOR")), no_color=bool(os.environ.get("NO_COLOR")))
    interactive = False
    show_help: Optional[str] = None
    idx = 0
    while idx < len(argv):
        arg = argv[idx]
        if arg in {"--help", "-h", "/?", "/h"}:
            show_help = LONG_HELP
            idx += 1
            break
        if arg == "--version":
            show_help = SHORT_HELP
            idx += 1
            break
        if arg in {"--interactive", "-i", "/i"}:
            interactive = True
            idx += 1
            continue
        if arg in {"--config", "-c", "/config"}:
            idx += 1
            if idx >= len(argv):
                break
            runtime.config_path = argv[idx]
            idx += 1
            continue
        if arg in {"--nocolor", "--no-color", "/nocolor"}:
            runtime.no_color = True
            idx += 1
            continue
        if arg == "--no-errors":
            runtime.show_errors = False
            idx += 1
            continue
        if arg == "--us-dates":
            runtime.us_dates = True
            idx += 1
            continue
        break
    query = " ".join(argv[idx:]).strip()
    return runtime, query, show_help, interactive


def run_query_text(text: str, runtime: RuntimeOptions) -> int:
    try:
        query = parse_query(text)
    except QueryError as exc:
        if runtime.show_errors:
            stderr(f"query: {exc}\n")
        return 2
    config_warning = load_config(runtime.config_path, runtime) if runtime.config_path else None
    if config_warning and runtime.show_errors:
        stderr(config_warning)
    result = execute_query(query, runtime)
    stdout(render_output(query, result))
    if result.errors and runtime.show_errors:
        for message in result.errors:
            stderr(message + "\n")
    return result.exit_code


def interactive_shell(runtime: RuntimeOptions) -> int:
    if runtime.config_path:
        warning = load_config(runtime.config_path, runtime)
        if warning and runtime.show_errors:
            stderr(warning)
    while True:
        try:
            line = input("query> ")
        except EOFError:
            return 0
        except KeyboardInterrupt:
            stdout("\n")
            return 0
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            continue
        lower = stripped.lower()
        if lower in {"exit", "quit"}:
            return 0
        if lower == "help":
            stdout(LONG_HELP)
            continue
        if lower == "pwd":
            stdout(os.getcwd() + "\n")
            continue
        if lower.startswith("cd "):
            path = stripped[3:].strip()
            try:
                os.chdir(path)
            except OSError as exc:
                if runtime.show_errors:
                    stderr(f"{path}: {exc.strerror} (os error {exc.errno})\n")
            continue
        if lower.startswith("errors"):
            parts = lower.split()
            if len(parts) == 1:
                runtime.show_errors = not runtime.show_errors
            elif parts[1] == "on":
                runtime.show_errors = True
            elif parts[1] == "off":
                runtime.show_errors = False
            stdout(f"Errors are {'ON' if runtime.show_errors else 'OFF'}\n")
            continue
        run_query_text(stripped, runtime)


def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
    runtime, query, show_help, interactive = parse_cli(argv)
    if show_help is not None:
        stdout(show_help + ("\n" if not show_help.endswith("\n") else ""))
        return 0
    if interactive:
        return interactive_shell(runtime)
    if not query:
        stdout(SHORT_HELP_WITH_HINT + "\n")
        return 0
    return run_query_text(query, runtime)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))
